### A Tragic Cycle
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/tragic-cycle
Passage: Judges 2:18-19
Points:
- Israel failed to fully remove the pagan inhabitants, presuming they could resist Canaanite idolatry on their own.
- Spiritual amnesia about God's mighty deeds quickly led the next generation into apostasy and false worship.
- God chose not to abandon Israel completely, leaving pagan nations in place to test their covenant loyalty.
- Moved by Israel's groaning under affliction, the Lord raised up judges to deliver them during each leader's lifetime.
- Following the death of each judge, the people relapsed into even deeper corruption and stubbornness.
- Believers must actively remember God's work daily to resist the pull of modern cultural idols.
